task_description: Create a comprehensive live deployment audit script at scripts/live-deployment-audit.sh that validates the entire production deployment of syrabit.ai with 500+ individual checks across infrastructure, security, performance, API completeness, data integrity, deployment config, compliance/SEO, and monitoring/observability

verification.summary: bash -n syntax check passes. --help shows comprehensive usage. --quick runs 21 checks and produces score. All 8 sections run independently (57+96+59+61+40+59+73+44 = 489 total checks). --export-json produces valid JSON. --export-html produces styled HTML report. Script correctly identifies real issues in live deployment.
